pluralRules.one-if-1: The count takes the 'one' form when it is exactly 1, and 'other' in every other case, zero included.

pluralRulesNote: A locale whose pluralRule is null has no rule pinned yet, and every runtime refuses it rather than borrowing another locale's -- English and Portuguese disagree about zero, and a borrowed rule reads as fluent, confident, wrong grammar to anyone who does not speak the language. Pinning a rule means transcribing it from a CLDR release and naming it here, so all three runtimes select the same form for the same count.
numberFormatNote: Separators are declared here rather than read from each runtime's own locale database. The browser floor has no Intl at all, and the ICU version behind a server runtime changes between releases; a table that lives in one place is the only way the same number reaches every reader identically.
